# kemp_virtual_services (Data Source)

Lists all virtual services configured on the LoadMaster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kemp_virtual_services" "all" {}

output "virtual_services" {
  value = data.kemp_virtual_services.all.virtual_services
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `virtual_services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_services))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_services`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Stable reference: <protocol>/<address>/<port>, or <parent id>/sub/<slot> for a SubVS.
- `index` (Number) Current index. It changes whenever the LoadMaster renumbers; use id to refer to virtual services.
- `nickname` (String)
- `parent_index` (Number) Index of the parent virtual service if this is a SubVS, otherwise 0.
- `port` (String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String) Service type (gen, http, http2, ts, tls, log).
